text_block_list.text:
It's the day of Мэдзиро Райан's debut. She's
pumped
up and ready to show off the
results of all her
training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm soon subsides, though,
when she
considers the other runners
also making their
debuts, and the
complex feelings they're surely

shouldering.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing this, Ines Fujin comes by and
offers some
words of support.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан, realizing that she has
people rooting
for her, regains her
composure and heads to the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
